preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 30.
The length of the permutation n must be between 1 and 30,000.
The maximum cost of the operation c must be between 1 and 4.
The number of queries q must be between 1 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p_i <= n for p_i in p) and len(set(p)) == n
preconditions.description: The permutation p must contain n unique integers from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= 10**18 for i, j in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must have valid indices i and j within the specified ranges.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if j > len(obtainable_permutations) else str(obtainable_permutations[j-1][i-1])
postconditions.description: The output must be the i-th number of the j-th permutation or -1 if the j-th permutation does not exist.
